div.div:
trĭbūtim , adv. tribus,
I.through each tribe, tribe by tribe, by tribes: “tributim et centuriatim descriptis ordinibus,” Cic. Fl. 7, 15 : legem centuriatis comitiis tulere, ut quod tributim plebes jussisset, populum teneret, i. e. in the comitia tributa, Liv. 3, 55, 3; cf. id. 7, 16, 7: “nummis tributim divisis,” Cic. Att. 4, 17, 1 : “spectacula tributim data,” id. Mur. 34, 72 ; cf. id. ib. 32, 67: “arripuit populum tributim,” Hor. S. 2, 1, 69 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
